source: But, as we’ve seen with Tlaltecuhtli and Tezcatlipoca, Aztec Gods rarely fit into a single category, and most are both creative and destructive, spiritual and material, especially the 13 major Gods.
claim: 85 of the 124 non-major gods and 10 of the 13 major gods carry more than one of the four thematic categories (life, death, spiritual expansion, material expansion); 39 and 3 respectively carry only one.
code: g[g['ID']!='cihuateteo'].assign(major=lambda x: x['type']!='secondary', ncat=lambda x: x['Field (4 thematics)'].fillna('').str.count(',')+1).groupby('major')['ncat'].agg(single=lambda s:(s==1).sum(), multi=lambda s:(s>1).sum(), total='size')

source: But Aztec Gods are rarely associated with a single domain.
claim: In the detailed Field (13 gods) classification, 19 of the 124 non-major gods have a single domain, while all 13 major gods have more than one.
code: g[g['ID']!='cihuateteo'].assign(major=lambda x: x['type']!='secondary', single=lambda x: x['Field (13 gods)'].fillna('').str.count(',')==0, multi=lambda x: x['Field (13 gods)'].fillna('').str.count(',')>0).groupby('major')[['single','multi']].agg(['sum','count'])

source: On the contrary, seemingly contradictory domains, like life and death, are often embodied by the same deity.
claim: In the four thematic categories, 30 of the 46 gods tagged with death are also tagged with life.
